# Achieving Your Material and Spiritual Goals

### Brother Chidananda • Self-Realization Fellowship

Welcome and blessings. Many people believe that material success and spiritual progress are at odds. However, our beloved Guru taught the art of balanced living — achieving complete material prosperity while establishing our deepest connection with God.

### Dual Success Through Divine Will

When we align our individual willpower with the Divine Will, we tap into an inexhaustible library of creativity, energy, and intelligence. True success is not just financial wealth, but the ability to remain dynamic, peaceful, and helpful to others under all circumstances.

> "God is the ultimate source of all prosperity. By seeking Him first in the temple of silence, you activate the creative forces of the cosmos to manifest success in all of your noble undertakings."

### The Importance of Spiritualized Willpower

Never approach your goals with a doubtful or hesitant mind. Apply yourself fully, knowing that the strength of the Infinite is behind you. Use the divine law of concentration to focus on one task at a time, eliminating all doubt.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Balanced Schedule:** Balance your daily schedule with both physical exercise, creative work, and structured meditation.
* **Spiritualized Action:** Work without anxiety, offering the fruits of your labor as a worship to the Divine.
* **Daily Target:** Set clear, noble goals each morning and carry them out with absolute determination.
* **Devotional Prayer:** Pray before every major project: *"Lord, guide my thoughts, action, and intellect to manifest Thy divine abundance."*

In His light you are secure. Jai Guru!
rawText: Achieving both material prosperity and spiritual peace is the natural result of balanced living. Our Master taught that when you seek God first in silence, you unlock the cosmic creativity to succeed...
